title: 多智能体LLM能否识别同类？角色约束政治分析中的笔迹指纹识别
summary: 研究多智能体LLM在政治声明分析中是否可通过笔迹指纹识别模型家族。发现提示级匿名化无法消除模型身份信号，T5模型在五类归属任务中达到Macro F1=0.991，证明笔迹特征可泛化。对欧盟AI法案合规及多智能体部署有直接影响。
summary_en: Investigates whether multi-agent LLMs can identify model families via stylometric fingerprints in political analysis. Finds prompt-level anonymization insufficient; T5 achieves Macro F1=0.991 in five-class attribution. Implications for EU AI Act compliance and multi-agent deployments.
